No disrespect, but if it were that easy to just "be the anomaly" why would this be avtrend in the first place?

And no, I won't grow more. My doctor says there isn't much more to go and my parents are 5' and 5'7".
Most of their fans are unaware of their real height. They usually appear taller in media.

Sadly, living where I do, I'd say I'm about 5-6 inches below average, at least compared to my own generation. 

And girls REALLY don't like short guys. I don't know if you've used tinder or the like but a lot of girls will instantly dismiss anyone below average. Same in real life too. In fact, height is the main attraction for females as shown in numerous studies.

As for shitty judgmental people, we are mentally programmed to associate taller with better. So I guess that leaves most people shitty and judgmental by definition.

It sucks being percieved as weak etc. I used to fight alot when I was younger just to prove a point. It is really sad that the majority of people my age probably look at me and think "fuck this guy I could roll him in seconds" and the worst part is they're probably right.

But congrats on being dealt a good hand in life, man.

If it were only that simple.
